@graph.name: Envision Marin
@graph.description: Envision Marin is the County's first Countywide Strategic Plan in 25 years, and we want to hear from you! Learn about the process, share what matters most to you, and follow how community input helps shape the plan.
@graph.text: The Marin Countywide Strategic Plan aligns the Board of Supervisors, County departments, and community partners around a small set of measurable goals. Every goal on this site links down to the objectives, initiatives, and projects that implement it, and up to the performance measures that track it — the plan itself is the JSON graph, not a PDF.
@graph.marin:vision: A Marin County where every resident has access to a safe, affordable place to live, a resilient environment, and a government that is easy to reach and easy to work with.
@graph.marin:mission: Align County departments, cities, towns, and community partners around a shared set of goals, and report progress against them openly and often.

marin:values.name: Equity
marin:values.description: Prioritize investments and services for residents and communities with the greatest need.

marin:values.name: Transparency
marin:values.description: Publish progress on every goal and KPI as structured, machine-readable data, not just narrative reports.

marin:values.name: Collaboration
marin:values.description: Work across County departments, cities, towns, and community organizations rather than in silos.

marin:aboutSections.heading: Planning for Marin's Future
paragraphs: Marin County is developing its first comprehensive Countywide Strategic Plan in more than 25 years. Envision Marin is the process of looking ahead, listening to communities across the County, and creating a shared direction for our future.

The plan will help guide County priorities, services, investments and decisions while connecting the work already underway across County government. It will align Board priorities, departmental workplans, budgets, capital planning and performance measures, around a shared direction, helping the County stay focused on what matters most to the people of Marin.

marin:aboutSections.heading: The County Is Listening
paragraphs: Community input is an important part of shaping the Countywide Strategic Plan.

This process is an opportunity to hear from people across Marin about their experiences, needs, priorities and hopes for the future. What we hear from the community will be considered alongside data, input from County staff, Board direction and perspectives from individuals, community organizations, businesses, cities and towns, and other partners.

You can participate now by sharing your ideas through Engage Marin, the County's online engagement platform. Additional opportunities are coming this fall, including community workshops, small-group conversations and opportunities to connect with us at community events.

marin:aboutSections.heading: From Listening to Action
paragraphs: Envision Marin is more than developing a plan. It is about creating a shared direction that can help the County turn priorities into coordinated action.

As input is gathered, the County will look for common themes, that will help shape the plan and share updates on the process along the way. Once adopted, the plan will help guide County priorities and investments across three two-year budget cycles over six years.

marin:aboutSections.heading: A Process for Everyone
paragraphs: Envision Marin is for everyone who lives, works, learns or does business in Marin County. We want to make it as easy as possible for people to participate, with focused outreach to communities that have historically been underrepresented and options for translation, interpretation, ADA accommodations and virtual participation whenever possible.

marin:newsletter.heading: Stay Connected
marin:newsletter.body: Sign up for the Envision Marin e-newsletter for periodic updates on the Countywide Strategic Plan, including upcoming opportunities to participate, important milestones, and project updates.

@graph.marin:closingTagline: Learn more. Make your voice heard. Help shape Marin's future.
